> Two of the new precontructed decks in KMW is called Alastor and Anathema.
> What does this mean in the roleplaying
> apects of WOrld of darkness?
>

The Anathema are the vampires on the Red List that others in vampire society
want hunted down and destroyed.

An Alastor is a vampire who takes up the role of hunting down and destroying
the Anathema.
